artworks.title: The Alba Madonna
artworks.description: The image shows three figures. The central figure is seated and holding a child who stands on her leg. The woman has rounded facial features, wavy hair, and is dressed in a flowing garment. She holds a book in her hand. Beside her, a nude child stands with outstretched arms. Another nude child is seated on her left, holding a cross. The background shows a natural setting with detailed plant life in the foreground and a serene landscape in the background, including mountains, buildings, and a cloud-speckled sky.

artworks.title: Do You Want Any Matches?
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a young boy standing on a street. The woman is upright, slightly turned to her right, with her head looking back towards the viewer. She has fair skin, a delicate nose, rosy cheeks, and rosy lips. Her hair is covered by a wide-brimmed bonnet tied under her chin, with some of her brown hair visible. She wears a dress with a blue skirt and a mauve top covered by a white apron. She holds a small bundle or packet in her hand and carries a wicker basket on her left arm.  The young boy stands next to her, facing the viewer with his mouth open. He has medium-length brown hair and wears a rust-brown jacket over a white shirt with blue shorts and a large dark hat. He clasps his hands around the basket strap hanging at his side. A brown and white dog stands beside them on the cobblestone road. In the background, there is a partial view of a carriage with large wheels on the left side, and grand stone columns of a building on the right side. The sky is partly cloudy with patches of blue visible.

artworks.title: A New Love Song Only a Ha'Penny a Piece
artworks.description: This is a painting of a street scene involving an exchange. The scene shows a group of figures engaging in a transaction. A woman is offering a sheet of music or lyrics to another figure. The figures are dressed in period clothing. A child and a dog are present. Architectural elements, like stone columns, suggest the location is a town or city square. This art style is reminiscent of Francis Wheatley.

artworks.title: Round and Sound, Five Pence a Pound, Duke Cherries
artworks.description: The image depicts four individuals in a street market setting. A woman stands beside a boy holding a basket. The woman has fair skin, blonde hair, wearing a yellow bonnet with a red ribbon, a white dress, and a blue apron. Two boys, one in a yellow outfit with a red cloak and the other in a brown hat and beige outfit, are looking at the basket. A man in a brown hat and blue jacket is beside them, holding a stick. A wheelbarrow with a basket and blankets is nearby. Classic architectural elements and large barrels are in the background.

artworks.title: Turnips and Carrots Ho
artworks.description: The image depicts two women outdoors. The primary figure is a woman facing slightly left with long, wavy hair under a wide-brimmed hat. She wears a long skirt, blouse, pink jacket, and blue apron. She holds turnips and green leafy vegetables. Beside her, a donkey carries a basket with turnips and carrots. Another young woman stands behind the donkey wearing a blue dress and a hat. The background shows an architectural setting with steps, an archway leading into a building, and a partly cloudy sky.

artworks.title: New Mack'rel
artworks.description: Three women are standing in front of a doorway. The woman on the left is holding a tray with fish and has fair skin. She is wearing a dark hat, a cream long-sleeved dress under a brown shawl, a blue apron, and her hair is tucked under her hat. The woman in the middle is wearing a soft hat and a blue dress with a coral sash, and has long, dark hair. The woman on the right has light brown hair pulled back under a white cap, fair skin, and is wearing a white dress with brown sleeves and a blue apron tied around her waist. She is holding her hands on her hips. In the background, there is a wooden doorway, stone steps, a low metal fence, a plastered wall, a window covered with a red curtain, and a large wicker basket on the ground.

artworks.title: Sweet China Oranges
artworks.description: The image shows three adults standing in a city street scene. A man in a brown coat and dark hat stands on the left, holding a basket of oranges. To his right, a woman in a light-colored dress and white shawl holds a few oranges while looking at the man. Behind her, another woman in a dark outfit with a shawl and bonnet looks at the man. In the background, there are stone arches and faded figures, suggesting an urban setting. Another basket of oranges is on the ground nearby.

artworks.title: Two Bunches a Penny, Primroses
artworks.description: The image shows three people standing outdoors in a courtyard. The main figure, a woman, is shown from the full body up, standing with a basket on her right arm filled with flowers. She has curly brown hair, wears a red and blue dress with a cream apron and black shoes. To her left are two children, a boy and a girl, holding small bunches of flowers and wearing bonnets. A brown and white dog stands in front of the woman. In the background is a stone building with arched windows and a seated woman on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Fresh Gathered Peas, Young Hastings
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene with a cart and various individuals gathered around it. The image depicts a historical scene where activities involving selling or distributing goods are taking place. A woman is standing beside a wooden cart while a man fills it with herbs or leafy greens from a basket. Another figure stands on the cart, with a small child and a dog nearby. The setting appears to be outdoors and urban, with a tall architectural structure in the distance. The painting features muted colors and a soft focus, resembling the style of artists who captured everyday scenes from life in 18th or 19th-century Europe.

artworks.title: Hot Spice Ginger Bread Smoking Hot
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals and a dog in an urban setting with stone columns in the background. A man in a red coat and gray trousers is holding a tray, a woman in light-colored clothing is holding something, and another woman wears a pink bonnet and shawl. A young boy in brown clothing is looking at the table, and a dog with a white and brown coat is standing nearby.

artworks.title: Old Chairs to Mend
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a domestic or workshop setting. A man is seated, repairing a chair. Behind him, two women stand holding more chairs. The woman closest wears a white apron over a pink dress, and the other wears a blue dress with a white blouse. A small dog is in the right foreground. The background features a rustic building with a thatched roof, an open window, and a wicker basket hanging on the wall. An open door reveals a distant structure surrounded by trees against a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Knives, Scissors and Razors to Grind
artworks.description: This is a painting of a knife grinder interacting with two women outside a building. The man in a brown coat and hat is next to a wheeled grinding apparatus. One woman in a white dress and bonnet is handing him an object, possibly a knife. Another woman is standing in the background, and an elder is seated in the background, facing away. The setting has gentle lighting and shadows, suggesting the evening or early morning. The scene is reminiscent of the style of Francis Wheatley.

artworks.title: Fortitude
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a woman's upper body and head in profile, facing to the right. She is seated and her upper body is partially turned towards the right side. Her facial features are detailed with a pronounced nose and chin. Her hair is styled elaborately with braided sections forming a headpiece. The woman wears a voluminous dress with puffed sleeves and ornate folds on the shoulder and chest, fastened with a circular brooch. Her right arm is extended towards a column next to her. The background features a simple architectural element with a plaque that reads "FORTITUDO 1528." The engraving is monochromatic with fine lines emphasizing texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Paris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with mythical elements. Four nude figures are standing around an armored fallen figure in a wooded landscape. Above them, a chariot is flying through the sky, drawn by animals and surrounded by beams of light. A castle is visible in the background. The drawing is intricately detailed and features a dramatic composition with classical motifs and symbols. The combination of earthly and ethereal elements creates a sense of drama and mystery.

artworks.title: Oblong Ornament Panel
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.1 x 1.8 cm (2 3/8 x 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a vertical rectangle filled with swirling lines and circular shapes, forming an abstract design. Within the composition are elements resembling leaves or flower petals encased in circular frames. One section contains a form reminiscent of a blooming flower. At the bottom, a shape evokes a seashell or horn, from which curved lines extend, adding a sense of organic growth to the design.

artworks.title: Erato
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing with one leg raised and leaning slightly forward. They are holding a circular object in their hands and appear focused. The person has long hair and is wearing a flowing garment. They are barefoot, and there is another similar object near their feet. The background shows hills and sparse vegetation.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Paris
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting fantastical elements including figures with helmets and armor, a tree, and cloud shapes. The drawing shows three intricate figures on the left with one holding a shield, positioned near a detailed tree and a cloud-like form above. To the right is a complex structure with a winged figure perched on top of the tree. In the lower area, a reclined figure wearing decorative armor is surrounded by smaller, humanoid forms. The detailed linework and shading create a textured and elaborate quality. The imagery suggests an inspiration from classical mythology or an allegorical theme.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie (Frontispiece)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man with a mustache and wavy hair, wearing an elaborate outfit. Surrounding the man is an oval frame with decorative elements and four cherubic figures engaged in various activities. Below the portrait is a banner with an inscription and the year "1637." The background is filled with intricate line work.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie (Title Page)
artworks.description: This is an image of a battle-themed scene with a banner inscribed "CAPRICCI DI VARIE BATTAGLIE di Gio Guglielmo Baur 1635." The drawing shows a mounted figure on horseback blowing a trumpet with a flag, alongside war implements like cannons and cannonballs in the foreground. Other figures in the background are raising flags and possibly preparing for battle. The image features strong lines, detailed shading, and a central focus on the large banner.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene on horseback. The image shows mounted soldiers engaged in combat, wielding weapons such as spears, swords, and bows. The horses and riders are shown in various poses, giving a sense of movement and chaos. The background is lightly sketched, suggesting an open terrain setting, with detailed and intricately drawn figures capturing the motion and action of the scene.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. Mounted soldiers are engaged in combat, depicted in energetic lines. The movement of the horses and gestures of the figures suggest high tension and action. Smoke in the background indicates gunfire, adding to the sense of turmoil. The scene is detailed, with each figure and animal carefully rendered, enhancing the drama and intensity of the composition.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battlefield scene. The drawing depicts a battlefield with numerous figures engaged in combat, some on horseback and others on foot. In the foreground, a figure stands with their back to the viewer, holding a large flag with a leaping feline figure holding an object. Surrounding this figure are other figures observing the battle below. Smoke and tumultuous activity dominate the background, suggesting chaos and movement. The sky is filled with dynamic clouds, enhancing the scene below. The style of the drawing reflects a classic etching or pen-on-paper representation common in historical depictions of war scenes.
